changes.evidence: Hawkeye episode 2 (Hide and Seek): Grills films his Ronin-suit video for his LARP group, posts it on the group's page (@newyorkcitylarpers), and plays in the NYC LARPers' Central Park session, dueling Clint; in episodes 4 and 6 he and the other LARPers help Kate (retrieving the arrows, then the Rockefeller Center party). A club shown on screen with sessions, an organizer (Missy) and members; Fandom lists him as a member of New York City Live Action Role Players.

owner_calls.question: Add his valet job at the San Francisco hotel (his years-long workplace with Katy, before the bus fight) as a stage between The Ten Rings and Ta Lo? The film never names the hotel (Fandom calls it the Fairmont San Francisco from the filming location), so it would need a name.
options: Add a hotel/valet employer stage (name to be chosen) after The Ten Rings, keyed to Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
owner_calls.evidence: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings: after fleeing the Ten Rings at 14, Shaun works as a hotel valet with Katy in San Francisco for years; Fandom lists 'Fairmont San Francisco (formerly)' among his affiliations.
